# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux architecture support changes**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp update drops Linux x86 native assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries are removed, following upstream .NET's retirement of Linux x86 cross-build infrastructure. Move affected deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading; do not rely on these packages to supply Linux x86 native binaries. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
